title: Quantum-Safe Network pilot scope for the Hong Kong leg
participants: Customer Head of Network Engineering; Singtel Client Partner
summary: Head of Network Engineering asked for a Quantum-Safe Network pilot design for the Hong Kong leg before the renewal paper goes to committee.
content:
From: Head of Network Engineering, LionRock Quantitative Bank
To: Singtel Client Partner
Subject: QSN pilot scope for the Hong Kong leg

Thanks for the latency readout. Our risk committee wants to see a Quantum-Safe Network pilot design for the Hong Kong leg before we table the renewal paper. Please include the pilot timeline, what changes on our side, and how the pilot would be measured. If the design can be ready by the second week of December, I can present it with the renewal.

title: Renewal pre-read preparation with procurement
participants: Customer Procurement Lead; Singtel Client Partner
summary: Procurement will benchmark the renewal against NTT's Hong Kong proposal. Anything above the delegated limit needs the CFO's sign-off.
content: Call notes. Procurement Lead confirmed the renewal paper goes to committee in January. They will benchmark our renewal against the managed low-latency network NTT pitched to the Hong Kong desk. Anything above the delegated limit needs the CFO's office to sign off, and the CFO's office has not been briefed yet. Agreed next step: Client Partner to request a 30-minute session with the CFO's office before the paper is final.

title: Market-open jitter follow-up
participants: Customer Head of Network Engineering; Singtel Client Partner
summary: Customer confirmed the jitter alarm cleared and asked for the latency report before 20 November.
content:
Head of Network Engineering: Jitter alarm at market open has been clean all week, thanks for the quick fix.
Head of Network Engineering: Could we have the latency report before the 20th? I want it in the committee pack.
Singtel Client Partner: Yes, the report will be with you by the 19th.

title: Formal complaint: Tuas failover during a vessel call
participants: Customer VP Fleet Operations and Maritime IT; Singtel Client Partner; Singtel Service Manager
summary: The VP Fleet Operations asked for a root cause and a service credit after the 52-minute failover at Tuas, and said the board has asked about alternatives.
content:
From: VP Fleet Operations and Maritime IT, Straits Vanguard Maritime Lines
To: Singtel Client Partner; Singtel Service Manager
Subject: Tuas failover during a vessel call

The SD-WAN failover at the Tuas berth operations centre took 52 minutes during a vessel call yesterday. Berth scheduling ran on paper for most of that time. We need a written root cause within five working days and a proposal for the service credit. Our board has asked whether we should look at alternatives before the December renewal.

title: Handover after the Head of Maritime IT left
participants: Customer Fleet IT Manager; Singtel Client Partner
summary: The Fleet IT Manager confirmed the Head of Maritime IT left on 15 September and is covering until a replacement is hired.
content:
From: Fleet IT Manager, Straits Vanguard Maritime Lines
To: Singtel Client Partner
Subject: Handover

Our Head of Maritime IT left the company on 15 September. I am covering the network programme until a replacement is hired, but I do not have sign-off on the renewal. Please send technical updates to me and copy the VP Fleet Operations on anything commercial.

title: M1 port slice trial offer
participants: Customer Port Operations Manager; Singtel Client Partner
summary: M1 offered a 5G port slice trial at a lower monthly fee; procurement wants to compare it before the renewal.
content:
Port Operations Manager: M1 came in with a 5G port slice trial at a lower monthly fee. Procurement wants to compare before renewal.
Port Operations Manager: Can you send a summary of the IMO cyber controls in your proposal? Theirs does not cover it.
Singtel Client Partner: Sending the controls summary and the private 5G design today.

title: Overdue invoice SGT-INV-2026-4471
participants: Customer Accounts Payable team; Singtel Billing Specialist
summary: Accounts Payable is holding SGT-INV-2026-4471 until the Tuas service credit is agreed.
content: Call notes. Accounts Payable said SGT-INV-2026-4471 is on hold until the service credit for the Tuas failover is agreed in writing. No dispute on the line items themselves. Billing Specialist to confirm the credit amount with the Service Manager and send a revised statement.

title: IoT SIM charges on SGT-INV-2026-3345
participants: Customer Finance Manager; Singtel Billing Specialist
summary: Finance disputes SGT-INV-2026-3345: the IoT SIM charges do not match the number of activated trackers.
content:
From: Finance Manager, AeroPulse Aviation & Cargo
To: Singtel Billing Specialist
Subject: IoT SIM charges

Invoice SGT-INV-2026-3345 charges for more IoT SIMs than we have activated trackers at the cargo terminal. Please reconcile against the activation report we sent in July. We will not release payment for that invoice until the count is corrected.

title: Changi apron 5G+ business case
participants: Customer Head of MRO Technology; Singtel 5G+ Specialist; Singtel Client Partner
summary: The COO wants the apron 5G+ business case before the steering committee, including a coverage map of the apron stands.
content: Call notes. Head of MRO Technology said the COO will sponsor the apron 5G+ case if it shows turnaround time savings. They need a coverage map of the apron stands and a view of how tracker data moves from the IoT platform. Agreed next step: 5G+ Specialist to share the coverage map and a draft business case by mid-October.

title: Steering committee date moved
participants: Customer Head of MRO Technology; Singtel Client Partner
summary: The steering committee moved to 2 December; the customer asked for the 5G+ Specialist to attend.
content:
Head of MRO Technology: Steering committee has moved to 2 December.
Head of MRO Technology: Can your 5G+ specialist join? The COO will ask about the renewal and the apron together.
Singtel Client Partner: Yes, we will both be there. I will bring the renewal options as well.

title: Campus Wi-Fi refresh quote
participants: Customer Facilities Manager; Singtel Client Partner
summary: Facilities asked whether Singtel can match StarHub's lower monthly fee for the campus Wi-Fi refresh.
content:
From: Facilities Manager, Orchid Bay Medical Group
To: Singtel Client Partner
Subject: Campus Wi-Fi refresh

We have a quote from StarHub for the campus Wi-Fi refresh at a lower monthly fee than our current arrangement. Can Singtel match it? We need a response before the budget review in November.

title: Data residency for clinical AI pilots
participants: Customer Data Protection Officer; Customer CMIO; Singtel RE:AI Specialist
summary: The Data Protection Officer raised concerns about overseas model endpoints and asked for an in-country inference option.
content:
From: Data Protection Officer, Orchid Bay Medical Group
To: Singtel RE:AI Specialist
Cc: CMIO
Subject: Data residency for clinical AI

Our clinical AI pilots currently call model endpoints outside Singapore through a cloud reseller. I cannot approve moving them into production on that basis. Please describe an in-country inference option, where patient data is processed and stored, and how access is logged.

title: Imaging centre upload slowness
participants: Customer Group CIO; Singtel Solution Architect, Connectivity
summary: Image uploads at the Bukit Timah imaging centre slow down at peak hours; the CIO wants a capacity check before any quote.
content: Call notes. Group CIO reported slow image uploads at the Bukit Timah imaging centre between 9am and 11am. They want a capacity check on the near-net link before considering any upgrade quote. Solution Architect to run the check and report within two weeks.

title: Checkpoint sync to Bengaluru
participants: Customer Head of Research Computing; Singtel Service Manager
summary: The Bengaluru checkpoint sync stalled for 6 hours after partner tail maintenance; the customer asked for advance notice of maintenance.
content: Call notes. Head of Research Computing said checkpoint sync to Bengaluru stalled for 6 hours after maintenance on the partner tail circuit. Training jobs had to restart. They asked for 72 hours' notice of any partner maintenance. Service Manager agreed to add them to the maintenance notification list.

title: GPU capacity after the benchmark readout
participants: Customer Head of AI Platform; Singtel Digital InfraCo Specialist
summary: The Head of AI Platform asked for a quote for additional GPU capacity after the RE:AI benchmark readout.
content:
From: Head of AI Platform, HelixVeda Bio-AI
To: Singtel Digital InfraCo Specialist
Subject: GPU capacity

The benchmark results were strong and the CSO is supportive. Please quote additional GPU capacity on RE:AI for the next two quarters, with the option to colocate storage in the Nxera data hall. We would like the quote before the end of November.

title: Compute budget approved
participants: Customer CSO; Singtel Client Partner
summary: The CSO said the compute budget envelope was approved and asked for the RE:AI proposal by the end of the month.
content:
CSO: The board approved the compute budget envelope this morning.
CSO: Please send the RE:AI proposal by the end of the month so we can sign before the holidays.
Singtel Client Partner: Understood, proposal will be with you by 28 November.

title: Johor SEZ warehouse outage
participants: Customer Head of Regional Operations; Singtel Client Partner; NCS programme director
summary: The Johor SEZ warehouse link was down for 4 hours; regional operations asked for one accountable provider for the Johor link.
content:
From: Head of Regional Operations, Harbourline Logistics Group
To: Singtel Client Partner
Cc: NCS programme director
Subject: Johor SEZ outage

The partner tail circuit to the Johor SEZ warehouse was down for 4 hours yesterday. Cold-chain monitoring fell back to manual checks. I want one provider accountable for the Johor link end to end. Please propose a managed option.

title: Managed Johor link and the StarHub offer
participants: Customer Head of Regional Operations; Singtel Solution Architect, Connectivity
summary: StarHub has offered a cross-border Singapore-Johor link; the customer wants a managed Singtel option to compare.
content: Call notes. Head of Regional Operations confirmed StarHub has offered a cross-border Singapore-Johor link. They prefer to keep one provider across Singapore and Johor if Singtel can manage the partner tail with clear service levels. Solution Architect to scope CUBΣ over a managed partner tail for the Johor site.

title: Charges disputed after the billing cutover
participants: Customer CFO's office; Singtel Billing Specialist; NCS ERP Programme Manager
summary: The CFO's office disputed charges on SGT-INV-2026-4498 after the billing cutover.
content:
From: CFO's office, Harbourline Logistics Group
To: Singtel Billing Specialist
Cc: NCS ERP Programme Manager
Subject: SGT-INV-2026-4498

Invoice SGT-INV-2026-4498 shows duplicated monthly charges for the Pasir Panjang site after the billing cutover. We are disputing the invoice until a corrected version is issued.

title: Operations centre outage: recovery plan requested
participants: Customer Group CIO; Singtel Strategic Account Director
summary: The Group CIO forwarded the COO's request for a written recovery plan after both links to the operations centre were lost.
content:
From: Group CIO, Meridian Arcwell Group
To: Singtel Strategic Account Director
Subject: Operations centre outage

Forwarding the COO's note. Both the primary and backup links to the operations centre were lost for 2 hours 40 minutes after a fibre cut in a shared duct. The COO wants a written recovery plan showing route diversity for both links, with named owners, before the steering committee.

title: Singapore SD-WAN lot pricing
participants: Customer Group Procurement Manager; Singtel Strategic Account Director
summary: Procurement shared that StarHub bid the Singapore SD-WAN lot below our indicative pricing.
content:
From: Group Procurement Manager, Meridian Arcwell Group
To: Singtel Strategic Account Director
Subject: Singapore SD-WAN lot

StarHub has bid the Singapore site SD-WAN lot below your indicative pricing. Their scope does not include managed security or India coverage. Please confirm whether your bundle price holds and what is included that their bid does not.

title: Bengaluru and Jakarta RFP
participants: Customer Group CIO; Singtel Strategic Account Director; NCS Client Director
summary: The customer issued an RFP for the Bengaluru and Jakarta sites; NTT is invited and responses are due in December.
content: Call notes. Group CIO confirmed an RFP for the Bengaluru and Jakarta sites went out this week. NTT is invited, and so are we. Responses are due on 12 December. The CIO said a credible recovery plan for the operations centre will weigh in our favour.

title: SGT-INV-2026-8841 approval
participants: Customer Group Financial Controller; Singtel Billing Specialist
summary: Finance will not approve SGT-INV-2026-8841 until the SGD 9,900 service credit is netted.
content:
Group Financial Controller: We cannot approve SGT-INV-2026-8841 until the SGD 9,900 service credit is netted off.
Group Financial Controller: Can you confirm the corrected amount by Friday?
Singtel Billing Specialist: Checking with the Oracle billing team now, will confirm by Friday.
